title: Gis Map End to End
description: Get the gis map working end to end: the infinite-canvas tiled-map surface renders, and zooming, panning, LOD banding and the raster/vector tile pipeline are correctly implemented and performant in the s product (dev target s-react, port 6070).
summary: Verified the public React GIS launch end to end on port 6040, including watcher-driven materialization and activation. Fixed startup/discovery, daemon routing, publication contention, compiler outputs, compile errors, and map redraw/cancellation. All 17 map tests and focused infrastructure checks pass. Browser rendering, layers, style, zoom, selection and tile transport verified. Evidence and limitations: 📓️startup-verification.md. Generated outputs removed; development server left running.
